Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 2 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Cyclone "PAOLO"
Issued at: 11:00 AM, 03 October 2025(Friday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales and Bataan.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Batangas, Cavite and Quezon(Tayabas, Atimonan, Pagbilao, Lucena, Tiaong, San Antonio, Dolores, Sariaya, Candelaria, Perez, Alabat, Quezon, Calauag, Lopez, Guinayangan, Tagkawayan, Buenavista, Mulanay, San Narciso, Catanauan, General Luna, Macalelon, Gumaca, Pitogo, Unisan, Plaridel, Agdangan, Padre Burgos, Polillo, Burdeos, Panukulan, Jomalig, Patnanungan, San Francisco, San Andres).

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 PM today.

🌋 What is the Ring of Fire?
🔸 A horseshoe-shaped belt around the Pacific Ocean.
🔸 Approx. 40,000 km long.
🔸 Contains nearly 75% of the world’s volcanoes 🌋.
🔸 About 80–90% of global earthquakes ⚡ occur here.
🔸 Includes countries like Philippines, Japan, Indonesia, Chile, USA (California).
👉 Since the Philippines lies here, it frequently faces earthquakes and tsunamis.

data.text:
Good morning CT 🌞☕

Just a recap on my infofi journey so far...

@idOS_network campaign on wallchain will run for a month and we still have around 20 days before it ends. My highest achieved rank was 300+ and now I'm sitting at 600+. My fault for not being consistent and skipped for 3 days. idOS pushes for a self-sovereignty of personal data and that it will be reusable in other dApps and platforms as well. My take on this will always be on the positive side. Imagine not doing kyc over and over again. Saves time and effort for me!! 

On the other hand, @VeloraDEX has partnered with CelerNetwork for more efficient cross-chain routes, better liquidity sourcing and smarter trade execution. This is a big step to a more effective trades across dex. I've always been using decentralized exchanges when swapping and it's good to know that there is a better option. 

While @genome_protocol is pushing for a better infofi, adding Splice to wallchain leaderboard users this week. Splice will filter copy pasta, ai slops and low quality data into valuable information. Your behavior, quests, referrals will be your onchain identity across Genome ecosystem. 

These three are my top priority among the sea of infofi projects. I resonate with them. I think they will be very useful in my web3 journey. 

I don't just yap, I check whether a project will have an impact on me. 

On the other hand, unrelated to the above mentioned topics, the Philippines is once again tried with a tropical storm. I hope the Philippines will take a break this October. We've been struck with flooding, typhoons, earthquakes and volcano eruption. I pray for the safety of every living being here. 

Hope y'all have a blessed day.
